feeds.title: How to Pastel
feeds.description: My love of pastel and the enjoyment I receive from teaching about pastel inspired the creation of this website. On it, I want to offer not only my own workshops both on- and off-line but also tips and reviews and opinions, and all manner of information regarding pastels, their use and pastels did through the years old and new.

feeds.title: Mamut Pastels Blog
feeds.description: My name is Alain, I am the creator of MAMUT pastels. MAMUT is about making good pastels and a promise to oneself and authenticity, which comes from traditional handmade products, passion, and commitment. This is a marvelous journey and we would love to share it with you. Our goals, our creative process, our way of looking at the world. Pastel is not just a technique but a way of life!

feeds.title: Pastel Today
feeds.description: Master Artists share their ideas and techniques through in-depth, interactive articles. Accelerate your art by studying from the finest artists in the world. Pastel Today is a free publication for the pastel movement.

feeds.title: Painting my World
feeds.description: I am an artist and daily painter. I love to teach art and help others on their own art journey. I created this blog in 2005 when I began my journey with pastels. Busy raising my two children, I had not touched a paintbrush in 20 years. I was anxious to get past the 'pastel painting learning curve' so I challenged myself to paint a small daily painting and post it to this blog, just to keep me accountable.

feeds.title: Pastel Progress
feeds.description: Still Life Pastel paintings, with some notes on their genesis and progression. This blog is a development from my pastel directory, www.artistsinpastel.com where pastel artists the world over were featured, until developments in social media made it redundant. This is where I post new paintings from time to time, with some notes on their genesis, and whatever else comes to mind.

feeds.title: Pastel Society of Southern California Blog
feeds.description: Our goal is to bring together pastel artists in the Los Angeles and surrounding areas to learn together and to share experiences in the art of pastel painting. Get the latest news and updates on Pastel Society of Southern California.

feeds.title: Ivan Jones Artist Blog
feeds.description: Ivan Jones is an award-winning pastel artist creating unique & detailed artworks. Commissions are undertaken. Get the latest updates on Ivan's commisioned work in various art galleries, pastel arts, new arts and more!

feeds.title: Meg Bandarra Blog
feeds.description: Meg Bandarra is a Massachusetts-based artist, whose award-winning paintings are exhibited in shows and included in private collections around the country. Explore Meg's art pieces, new paintings and more!

feeds.title: Nina Squire Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nina Squire and I'm an artist and art tutor. In normal times I have a travelling studio - an easel, a set of soft pastels and a flask of coffee and I'm happy! Get the latest updates on my arts and artroom in my blog.

feeds.title: Jackson's Blog » Pastels
feeds.description: Find more about pastel arts, meet various artists and more! At the heart of Jackson's is a commitment to empowering artists by providing a varied choice of quality fine art materials, and through sharing knowledge.
